_about: The tolerant reading of the matching rule (thesis 4.3.6). Kinyarwanda grammar, written by the editor: the code holds none of its own. While both lists are empty, runs report the strict reading only. Prefixes are noun-class prefixes as they may begin a word, with and without the initial vowel where it can drop (write each form you want stripped). Connectives are the forms a connective takes between two words, elided ones with their apostrophe. Change the version whenever the lists change: every run logs the version and this file's SHA-256.
